baseline: R14 local gamma0.6, reuse exact original predictions and detailed TrackEval
matching: frozen R20 Hungarian maximum IoU then IoU>=0.5; matched_gt_id>=0

positive_partition.semantic_FP: p>=.6 and matched and not y

GarbageOracle: only set unmatched candidate scores to0; all matched scores unchanged
SemanticOracle: on matched candidates only, flip semantic FP to0 and semantic FN to1; preserve all other scores including unmatched
combined_oracle: reuse R20 tracker_oracle; verify composing the two interventions gives the same gamma decisions for all1850576 rows
field_audit: all862 released files have9columns, columns7/8/9 constant1; no informative detection confidence
rule_features: sequence-local total observed track length, offline includes future
original tracker float width*height per row
rule_form: keep candidate iff track_length>=L and box_area>=A; identical mask for all expressions in a sequence, no YesTrack score/GT/image feature

LOSO.objective: maximize official HOTA.combine_sequences over queries of the other3complete sequences
LOSO.evaluation_schedule: evaluate each grid setting per video with exact per-video seqmap; never compute/use whole-val grid HOTA for parameter selection; merge heldout decisions and run full official TrackEval once
LOSO.equivalent_masks: exact expression-independent boolean-mask equality may reuse prior per-video evaluation, record every grid pair and alias; identity uses R14 per-query metrics

Rule_LOSO_captured_garbage_oracle: diagnostic only: use frozen LOSO rule mask but suppress only unmatched candidates rejected by it; oracle labels used for this audit, not a deployable filter

HOTA_attribution.primary: garbage-first sequential: H(G)-H0; semantic residual H(both)-H(G); sums to original R20-H0 space
HOTA_attribution.also_report: independent semantic gain H(S)-H0, interaction H(both)-H(G)-H(S)+H0, two-factor symmetric Shapley allocation

recovery_fractions.remaining_garbage: H(G)-H(captured_garbage); also show H(G)-H(rule_LOSO) as net gap, distinct meanings

interpretation_limit: remaining space is not recovered by this prespecified length/area rule family; it does not prove images are mathematically necessary
